name: view_connection_overlay
description: The connection overlay's five states as drawn over a match (net_overlay_states follows them through a networked window; this one sets them, so a rendered run takes seconds): a small bronze plate above the console's crest, never a modal, the title in the console's bold serif and a quieter line under it, and for reconnecting and catching up the loading screen's trough and gold fill with its share. The plate lets clicks through to the field, sits inside the window, and fades out when the state clears.

steps.assert: scene.overlay().visible and scene.overlay().lines() == ['Reconnecting...', 'your towers keep firing'] and scene.overlay().text() == 'Reconnecting...  your towers keep firing 50%'
scene.overlay().mouse_filter == 2 and node('Plate').mouse_filter == 2 and node('Bar').is_visible_in_tree() and node('Percent').text == '50%'
steps.msg: it lets clicks through, and shows the bar with its share
the plate sits inside the window

steps.assert: scene.overlay().lines() == ['Catching up', ''] and node('Percent').text == '62%' and node('Bar').is_visible_in_tree()
scene.overlay().lines() == ['In another tab', 'The caretaker kept your seat'] and not node('Bar').is_visible_in_tree()
steps.msg: in another tab: no bar, the caretaker's word

steps.eval: scene.overlay().show_state(5, -1, 'The caretaker hands back after this wave')

steps.assert: scene.overlay().lines() == ['Welcome back', 'The caretaker hands back after this wave'] and not node('Bar').is_visible_in_tree()
steps.msg: back and level: when the caretaker hands the seat back

steps.assert: scene.overlay().lines() == ['The lands fell out of step', 'A report was saved']

steps.msg: and it fades out when the state clears
